The broader multi-tablet campaign remains outside the approved scope. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

T382’s broader multi-tablet campaign was declined; the later execution list does not reopen it. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

Benchmark completion stopped relaunching the app, preserving whichever foreground app the user chose. Three automated regressions failed before the change and passed afterward; no physical-device trial was needed for these host calls. Retained concise original prose with explicit historical context; review map explains the result.

Decoder changes gained configuration receipts so acknowledgements from an old decoder could not certify a new selection. The receipts identify requested configuration, not effective hardware hints or optical presentation. Legacy behavior described here belongs to the dated implementation. Retained concise original prose with explicit historical context; review map explains the result.

FIFO cleanup was tied to the exact pipe its owner created, preventing an unused capture manager from deleting a live session’s path. Automated regressions reproduced the deletion and verified the fix; attribution of the earlier live interruption remains an inference. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

Thirty controlled starts did not reproduce the Android foreground-service timeout. They neither established its cause nor proved it fixed. The missing evidence was a reproducible sequence or timestamped failure trace; the old blocked status is historical, not a current ledger entry. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

This is a dated audit, not a guarantee that the present repository contains no secrets. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

A live encoder change resumed playback after a missing FIFO caused roughly 21 seconds of recovery. Later tests fixed an ownership bug, but this trace alone cannot identify the deleting process. The saved settings were personal choices, not project defaults or a proven battery improvement. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

The inspected GUI saved encoder settings before requesting a full daemon restart. Isolated tests verified that route, not the cause or duration of the user’s original interruption. An encoder-only update and a full restart have different lifetimes. Added a plain-language result and limits; retained original evidence in an expandable reference.

The dated negotiation extension matched encoder output with advertised decoder capabilities and tested bounded metadata and stale selections. A physical inventory query measured advertised support, not decoding performance. Its version-one compatibility path has since been superseded by the current protocol-two-only contract. Retained concise original prose with explicit historical context; review map explains the result.

Stock FFmpeg filters made timestamps strictly increasing while retaining forward time gaps. Synthetic and isolated GPU checks verified frame order and keyframes; they did not measure display latency or battery use. A separate missing startup picture was not solved by this change. Retained concise original prose with explicit historical context; review map explains the result.

The first AppImage packaging work verified independent process extraction lifetimes and bundled userspace dependencies in an isolated container. It did not validate physical capture or GPU compatibility. Release formats and migration wording in this dated report are not current installation instructions.
